To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we have generated an ORFeome clone collection of 1,282 TF genes in the pENTR vector and (ii) the ORFeome clones are highly efficient in expressing the respective Arabidopsis TF proteins in yeast cells.
We report our effort in cloning the ORFeome of Arabidopsis transcription factors (TFs).

1,282 TF genes in Arabidopsis have been cloned into the Gateway high throughput ORFeome cloning vector, and 411 of them have been annotated with no cDNA support, and 34 of them are not consistent with either the cDNAs or the predicted open-reading frame sequences, and 34 TFs are differentially expressed among 18 different Arabidopsis tissues and the cultured cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cloning of ORFeomes of all Arabidopsis TFs, the identification of novel TFs, and the expression profile analysis of these genes.
the generation and analysis of an Arabidopsis transcriptional regulatory gene ORFeome, which will be an important resource for functional genomics and molecular breeding research in Arabidopsis.
the generation of an Arabidopsis TF ORFeome, which should provide a useful resource for the study of the function and regulation of TFs in plants.

this ORFeome collection represents a valuable resource for the Arabidopsistranscriptional research community, and the ORFeome clones generated in the Gateway vector system can be readily transferred into a variety of expression and functional assays.
the current ORFeome collection represents the most complete and reliable set of Arabidopsis TF gene clones to date.
the ORFeome clones generated here provide a powerful tool for functional characterization of Arabidopsis TFs.

the Arabidopsis ORFeome collection provides an excellent platform for functional analysis of the Arabidopsis TFs, which will be useful to the plant research community at large.
